failures.question: Does this policy reimburse flights or inter-city trains?
failures.answer:  This policy does not specify reimbursement for inter-city rail or air travel. Such requests must be referred to the corporate travel team.  The standard one-way ad-hoc trip reimbursement cap is INR 900 per employee per trip.  Any amount above the cap requires written approval from the transport manager before the trip is confirmed.  This version replaces TechNova Employee Commute Policy version 1.0 from its effective date.  It governs company-sponsored employee ground transport for approved work-related travel in India.

failures.question: Are contractors eligible for commute?
failures.answer:  Guests are not permitted in employee commute vehicles, including business visitors.  Business visitor transport must be booked through the visitor transport desk and charged to the host department.  Employees assigned to an office-based or hybrid role may use the standard commute service on their scheduled office days.  Employees whose approved shift ends at or after 9:00 PM may request a company-funded drop, subject to availability.  This policy defines company-sponsored ground transport for employees travelling to and from approved DataSphere work locations in India.  The policy applies to employee commute bookings and approved business transport.

failures.question: Can I claim reimbursement for home-to-airport travel?
failures.answer:  This policy does not define home-to-airport reimbursement. Employees must consult the business-travel policy owner.  The standard one-way ad-hoc trip reimbursement cap is INR 1,000 per employee per trip.  A higher amount requires written approval from the regional transport manager before booking confirmation.  This policy defines company-sponsored ground transport for employees travelling to and from approved DataSphere work locations in India.  The policy applies to employee commute bookings and approved business transport.
